indexes.//: src/data/persistence.ts subscribes one listener per store rather than one for the whole organisation — attendance alone is thousands of documents a year, and a page that only needs the ticket list should not stream them. That query filters on orgId and store together, which Firestore cannot serve from single-field indexes.
src/lib/attendanceStamps.ts — an employee's own stamps. The rules require the query to filter on employeeId as well as orgId, so this index is what makes a legal read possible at all.
src/lib/orgFeed.ts — the board, newest first, scoped to one organisation. Ordering on the server so a page limit later takes the right subset rather than reordering it.
